ownerRef.description: The owner the figures are for (ADR 0045). Omitted for fleet-owned stock.

usable.description: On-hand minus active reservations minus held/unlocated stock, summed across the StockUnits of this SKU owned by `ownerRef` (loose stock and sealed cases alike, in eaches).

looseUsable.description: The part of `usable` a `quantity` reservation can draw on (loose stock only).

reservableCases.description: How many whole sealed cases can still be reserved with `cases`.
